This sounds like it may need professional medical care, which the guides on this device cannot replace. If it is life-threatening, call 911 (the Philippines emergency hotline) or go to the nearest hospital now. Keep the person calm and still, and do not give food, drink, or medicine unless a health professional says to. I can share general first-aid preparedness steps from the guides, but for an active emergency, get help from a person.

RescueDesk AI is built for emergencies and keeps your information private by design.
WHAT WE STORE: your household plan, meeting places, emergency contacts, notes, and go-bag checklist. All of it is saved only on this phone.
WHAT WE NEVER DO: no account or sign-up, no internet is required for guides, no location tracking, no chat history is kept, no analytics or ads, and nothing you enter is uploaded to any server.
YOUR RIGHTS (Data Privacy Act of 2012, RA 10173): you can view, change, or delete your information any time. Use \"Delete all personal information\" in this screen to erase everything from this device at once. Because no data leaves your phone, there is nothing for us to delete on our side.
WHO OPERATES THIS APP: the RescueDesk AI team. Backup and device-transfer are turned off, so your emergency data is not copied to Google or another phone without your action.
This app gives general preparedness guidance, not professional, medical, or legal advice. In a real emergency, contact local authorities and follow official instructions.

Turn this on to let a Gemma 2 2B IT language model running on this device rephrase the grounded answer into a shorter, natural paragraph. This is the Phase 1 candidate evaluation path only. The shipping answer stays retrieval-grounded to the guide text either way, and every safety refusal (live claim, out-of-scope, medical emergency) is enforced before the model is asked. Turning it off returns Ask AI to the default composed answer, with no effect on the guides.
Ready — grounded answers will be rephrased

To test on a physical phone: agree to the Gemma license on huggingface.co/litert-community/Gemma2-2B-IT, download `Gemma2-2B-IT_multi-prefill-seq_q8_ekv1280.task` (~2.7 GB) with the Hugging Face CLI, rename it to `gemma2b.task`, then `adb push gemma2b.task /data/local/tmp/rescuedesk/`. Free at least 3 GB storage; a phone with 8 GB RAM is recommended. The app checks `/data/local/tmp/rescuedesk/gemma2b.task`, then the app\'s own `files/models/`.

Why this app exists: in an emergency, every second without clear guidance puts a family at risk. The Philippines faces roughly twenty typhoons a year, plus earthquakes, fires, and floods — yet much of the lifesaving information lives in apps that need internet, accounts, or a data plan. RescueDesk AI keeps tested emergency guidance fully on this device, in Filipino and English, built for every age and eyesight. No accounts. No tracking. Nothing uploaded about you or your family. Because being prepared should not depend on signal strength.
